patches.note_zh: 10.0.3 调整 The Slasher 反蹲守与多项附加组件、更新 Cross-Examination，并为 7 月 28 日至 8 月 18 日的 Summer Screams 三周轮换（Chaos Shuffle / Lights Out / 2v8）做准备，同时集中修复 2v8、音频、角色、地图、Perk 与 UI 问题。
patches.note_en: 10.0.3 tunes The Slasher anti-camp rules and add-ons, updates Cross-Examination, sets up the Jul 28-Aug 18 Summer Screams rotation (Chaos Shuffle / Lights Out / 2v8), and ships a broad bug-fix pass across 2v8, audio, characters, maps, perks, and UI.

patches.note_zh: 10.0.2 重新启用周年活动队列中的 Doctor，下调 The Slasher 的 Deputy’s Badge 触发范围，并集中修复 Black Banquet、音频、角色与地图问题。
patches.note_en: 10.0.2 re-enables The Doctor in the anniversary queue, nerfs The Slasher’s Deputy’s Badge trigger range, and fixes a broad set of Black Banquet, audio, character, and map issues.

patches.note_zh: 10.0.1 为 6 月 25 日上线的 Black Banquet 活动预热，同时实装 Shane Wiigwaas、调整 Cross-Examination，并修复大量音频、角色、地图、Perk 与 UI 问题。
patches.note_en: 10.0.1 prepares the June 25 Black Banquet event, ships Shane Wiigwaas, tunes Cross-Examination, and delivers a broad bug-fix pass across audio, characters, maps, perks, and UI.

patches.note_zh: 10.0.0 正式服上线 Jason 章节与 The Slasher，同步加入 Aura 自定义、Killer Power Match Details 页，并修复大量角色、音频与地图问题。
patches.note_en: 10.0.0 brings the live Jason chapter and The Slasher, plus aura customization, a Killer Power Match Details tab, and a large bug-fix pass across characters, audio, and maps.

patches.note_zh: 10.0.0 PTB 开放 Jason 章节测试，带来 The Slasher、Omnipresent Evil / Throwing Spikes 能力，以及新一轮 Perk 与 UI 变更。
patches.note_en: 10.0.0 PTB opens the Jason chapter test with The Slasher, Omnipresent Evil / Throwing Spikes, and a fresh round of perk and UI changes.

patches.note_zh: 9.6.2 以稳定性与错误修复为主，覆盖 2v8、音频、角色、地图、Perk、平台兼容和闪烁灯光问题。
patches.note_en: 9.6.2 is a stability-focused hotfix covering 2v8, audio, characters, maps, perks, platform compatibility, and flashing-light fixes.

store.name: 黎明杀机
store.short_description: 10年恐惧相伴。10年的惊吓与刺激体验。10年的残暴献祭与惊险逃脱。永久困于邪恶的幻境之中，即使死亡也无法逃脱，这是一场需要勇气和智慧的较量，四名意志坚定的逃生者在残忍对局中面对嗜血杀手。选择一方，进入多人非对称竞技游戏世界，获得最佳恐怖游戏体验。
store.short_description_en: 10 years of horror. 10 years of jump scares and close calls. 10 years of brutal sacrifices and thrilling escapes. Trapped forever in a realm of eldritch evil where even death is not an escape, four determined Survivors face a bloodthirsty Killer in a vicious game of nerve and wits.

collaborations.name: Friday the 13th / Jason
collaborations.note_zh: Jason 正式落地十周年节点，仍是当前最强拉新与话题驱动点。
collaborations.note_en: Jason landing on the 10th anniversary remains the clearest current acquisition and conversation driver.

collaborations.name: Attack on Titan
collaborations.note_zh: 2v8 回归叠加 Attack on Titan 主题装扮，强化短期活动话题。
collaborations.note_en: The 2v8 return paired with Attack on Titan cosmetics reinforces short-term event buzz.

collaborations.name: Darkest Dungeon
collaborations.note_zh: Ruin Rift 把外部黑暗奇幻 IP 接入 Rift 商业化循环。
collaborations.note_en: The Ruin Rift connects an external dark-fantasy IP directly into DBD's Rift monetization loop.

collaborations.name: Resident Evil
collaborations.note_zh: 头部游戏 IP，持续覆盖动作恐怖用户。
collaborations.note_en: A flagship game IP that keeps DBD relevant to action-horror players.

collaborations.name: Stranger Things
collaborations.note_zh: 长期高认知影视联动，适合回流与社媒传播。
collaborations.note_en: A long-running mainstream crossover with strong return-user and social-media value.

collaborations.name: Silent Hill
collaborations.note_zh: 经典恐怖 IP，稳定强化品牌调性。
collaborations.note_en: A classic horror IP that consistently reinforces the game's tone.

positives_zh: 过去 30 天均值约 6.92 万、24 小时峰值 8.47 万，十周年高点回落后仍维持头部活跃盘。
总评测约 92.44 万、总体好评率 78.4%，长期口碑仍稳在 Mostly Positive 档位。
7 月 30 日 Chorus of Sin Early Access、7 月 29 日 Summer Screams 与 7 月 28 日 Pride 活动连续上新，LiveOps 节奏依旧密集。
10.0.3 已开始集中修复周年后 The Slasher、活动模式、角色、地图、音频与 UI 问题。
negatives_zh: 当前在线约 5.72 万，低于 SteamCharts 最近 30 天均值 6.92 万与 24 小时峰值 8.47 万。
近 30 天评测为 9011 条、78% 好评，短期口碑仍受活动 bug、平衡和兼容性摩擦影响。
BHVR patch notes 列表页当前抓取异常：patchnotes URL 仅稳定返回 10.0.2 页面标题，最新 10.0.3 仍需依赖 Steam 官方公告镜像交叉确认。
Steam 国区 appdetails API 继续出现 429，价格需要回退商店页 HTML 校对。
positives_en: The last-30-day average is still about 69.2k with an 84.7k 24-hour peak, so DBD remains a large-scale live game after the anniversary spike.
Total reviews are now about 924.4k at 78.4% positive, keeping the long-term rating firmly in the Mostly Positive band.
Chorus of Sin Early Access on Jul 30, Summer Screams on Jul 29, and the Jul 28 Pride beat keep the live-ops cadence packed.
Patch 10.0.3 has started cleaning up post-anniversary issues across The Slasher, event modes, characters, maps, audio, and UI.
negatives_en: Current concurrency is about 57.2k, below the 69.2k last-30-day average and the 84.7k 24-hour peak shown on SteamCharts.
Recent reviews are 78% across 9,011 reviews, so short-term sentiment is still being dragged down by event bugs, balance friction, and compatibility issues.
The BHVR patch-notes listing remains unstable: the patchnotes URL only reliably exposes a 10.0.2 page title, so the latest 10.0.3 details still need Steam official-announcement cross-checking.
The CN appdetails API keeps returning 429, so price validation still has to fall back to the store HTML.
